versions.changelog:
- Initial release of zhihu-geo-draft-assistant.
- Transforms AI-GEO content assets into Zhihu-friendly Q&A, analytical, and low-advertising drafts for human review before publishing.
- Enables brands and operators to safely convert materials into Zhihu’s rational, analytical style using Human-in-the-loop methods.
- Provides multi-format outputs: question candidates, long/short answers, ad-free versions, article drafts, attractive titles, topics/tags, and a publishing checklist.
- Includes a browser-assist script for manual Zhihu draft filling; all final reviews and publishing actions are strictly human-operated.
- Adheres to strong content quality and platform compliance standards, prohibiting automatic publishing or spam-like activity.
